senses.gloss: तु ind. (never used at the beginning of a sentence) 1. But, on the contrary, on the other hand, आचारेण तु संयुक्तः संपूर्णफलभाग् भवेत् M.i.109; (in this sense, तु is often preceded by परम् or किम् and the form परंतु or किंतु is always used first in a sentence); 2. as to, as for, as regards, चंद्रोपरागं प्रति तु केनापि विप्रलब्धासि Mud.i.; 3. and now, on one’s part, अवनिपतिस्तु तामनिमेषलोचनो ददर्श Kad.; 4. it is sometimes used as an emphatic particle, e.g. भीमस्तु पांडवानां रौद्रः G.M. and sometimes as a mere expletive, (निरर्थकं तुहीत्यादि पूरणैकप्रयोजनम्).
